<title>KITE &amp; SURF CAMPS - FUERTEVENTURA KITESURF SURF &amp; SAILING SCHOOL</title>


		
	<meta name="description" content="We offer a family atmosphere and personalized coaching. Our courses at CBCM Kitesurf &amp; Surf Camps have already attracted many riders. They return each year. Depending on the conditions, we go kitesurfing, surfing or stand up paddling. A Watersports course, in which your instructor guides you in the practice of action sports. The Kite &amp; Surf Camps take place in a cool atmosphere with &quot;Aloha&quot; spirit. We accompany you according to weather conditions. We go kitesurfing on windy days and surfing on good waves. Stand up paddle is for physical training. You can go mountain biking, jet skiing, or enjoy an MX Enduro Electric ride. Other activities include quads, golf, fitness, yoga, and massage. Rent a catamaran sail (38 and 42 feet) or a speed boat to visit the island of LOBOS Marine." />

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><span style="color: #ff0000">KITESURF &amp; SURF CAMP  890 € &nbsp;</span></strong>(7 nights in Surfcamp Bedrooms. This includes 5 sessions of 3 hours of Kitesurf or Surf  * Flight not included. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">(Breakfast, Wifi, and towels are included, Easy access to common areas.)</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We offer a family atmosphere and personalized coaching. Our courses at CBCM Kitesurf &amp; Surf Camps have already attracted many riders. They return each year.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Depending on the conditions, we go kitesurfing, surfing or stand up paddling. A Watersports course, in which your instructor guides you in the practice of action sports. The Kite &amp; Surf Camps take place in a cool atmosphere with &#8220;Aloha&#8221; spirit. We accompany you according to weather conditions. We go kitesurfing on windy days and surfing on good waves. Stand up paddle is for physical training. You can go mountain biking, jet skiing, or enjoy an MX Enduro Electric ride. Other activities include quads, golf, fitness, yoga, and massage. Rent a catamaran sail (38 and 42 feet) or a speed boat to visit the island of LOBOS Marine.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>+33 614 641 152 <span style="color: #ff0000">France</span> / &nbsp;&nbsp;+34 659 203 656 <span style="color: #ff0000">Spain</span> /</strong><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;kiteschool-cbcm@live.com</strong></p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>KITESURF &amp; SURF TRAINING CAMP </strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>&nbsp;<span style="color: #ff0000">890 €</span>&nbsp; 1 pers / <span style="color: #ff0000">1430 €</span>&nbsp; 2 pers : Double room shared Bathroom + Breakfast + Kite &amp; surf</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><span style="color: #ff0000">&nbsp;995 €</span>&nbsp; 1 pers / <span style="color: #ff0000">1535 €</span>&nbsp; 2 pers : Double room private bathroom + Breakfast + kite &amp; surf</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><span style="color: #ff0000">1135 €</span>&nbsp; 1 pers: Large Room for 3 pax + Breakfast ( 1 or 3 pers )&nbsp;+ kite &amp; surf</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong> <span style="color: #ff0000">1205 €</span>&nbsp; 1 pers: Large Room for 4 pax + Breakfast ( 1 or 4 pers ) + kite &amp; surf</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><span style="color: #ff0000">5 Days</span> Kitesurf &amp; Surf coaching</strong><br><span style="color: #ff0000">7 Nights</span>&nbsp;Accommodation : SURF HOSTAL</p>
